answer.final_answer: I recommend the 'Golden Trumpet' (Latin: Allamanda nerifolia) for your mom's living room. This flowering plant belongs to the Apocynaceae family and is originally from Brazil. It ideally thrives in tropical climates and requires 6 or more hours of direct sunlight per day. When it comes to watering, keep it moist and water when the soil is half dry. This plant is known to attract Mealy bug, Scale, and Spider mite. However, it does not have common diseases. Providing these conditions, this plant will absolutely add a pop of color to the living room!
